## library
```{r}
library(conflicted)
library(tidyverse)
library(ensembldb)
library(DESeq2)
library(gage)
library(gageData)
library(ggvenn)
library(gplots)
library(patchwork)
library(clusterProfiler)

library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(DOSE)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(ggnewscale)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggpubr)

source('utils.R')
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter)
conflicts_prefer(clusterProfiler::slice)
```


## Load data

```{r}
load("../Data/RNA_salmon_imported.Rdata")
out <- "../Result/RNAseq/"
if (!dir.exists(out)) {
  dir.create(out, recursive = TRUE)
}
```


## Sample and subjects
```{r}
liverMD |> dplyr::count(Facility, SamplingWeeks, Sex) 

ileumMD |> dplyr::count(Facility, SamplingWeeks, Sex) 

```

## Liver 
### DESeq design
```{r}
liverMD$age_fac_sex <- paste(liverMD$SamplingWeeks, liverMD$Facility, liverMD$Sex, sep="_")
liverMD$age_fac_sex <- factor(liverMD$age_fac_sex)
liver_dds <- DESeqDataSetFromTximport(txi=liver_txi, colData=liverMD, design=~age_fac_sex)
liver_dds <- DESeq(liver_dds)
liver_res <- results(liver_dds)
save(liver_dds, file = "../Data/liver_dds.Rdata")
```

### Figure S6. PCA, Volcano, Venn diagrams of liver
```{r}
### PCA
vsdata <- vst(liver_dds, blind=FALSE)
p <- plotPCA(vsdata, intgroup=c("Sex", "SamplingWeeks", "Facility"), returnData=TRUE)
percentVar <- round(100 * attr(p, "percentVar"), 2)
p$age_sex_fac <- paste0("Week ", liverMD$SamplingWeeks, ", ", liverMD$Sex, ", ", liverMD$Facility)
p <- p[order(p$age_sex_fac),]

mat <- t(assay(vsdata))
meta <- as.data.frame(colData(liver_dds))
set.seed(1)
perm_liver <- vegan::adonis2(
  mat ~ (Sex+SamplingWeeks+Facility), 
  data = meta,
  method = "euclidean",
  permutations = 999, 
  by="margin"
)

g_pca <- ggplot(p, aes(PC1, PC2, color=age_sex_fac)) +
  geom_point(size=3, aes(color=age_sex_fac, shape=age_sex_fac)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(17, 2, 17, 2, 16, 1, 16, 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#f9966d", "#f9966d", "navy", "navy", "#f9966d", "#f9966d", "navy", "navy")) +
  xlab(paste0("PC1 (", percentVar[1], "%)")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2 (", percentVar[2], "%)")) +
  labs(color = "Group", shape = "Group") +
  theme_bw() + theme_all

ggsave(file = paste0(out,"Liver_PCA_FigureS6A.pdf"),
       plot = g_pca, width = 6, height = 3, units = "in", dpi = 300, device = "pdf")

### Volcano
g_v_week4_M <- plotting_volcano(liver_dds,"4_Farm_Male","4_Vivarium_Male")
g_v_week4_F <- plotting_volcano(liver_dds,"4_Farm_Female", "4_Vivarium_Female")
g_v_week12_M <- plotting_volcano(liver_dds,"12_Farm_Male","12_Vivarium_Male")
g_v_week12_F <- plotting_volcano(liver_dds,"12_Farm_Female","12_Vivarium_Female")

save_fixed_panels(plots = list(g_v_week4_M, g_v_week12_M, g_v_week4_F, g_v_week12_F),
                  ncol = 2, shared_legend = TRUE,
                  filename = paste0(out, "Liver_valcano_FigureS6BCDE.pdf"),
                  tags = c("B","C","D","E"))

### Venn diagram
p_cutoff = 0.05
fc_cutoff = 1
age_fac_color = c("#7fc97f","#beaed4","#fdc086", "#ffff99")

#up in Vivarium
res <- results(liver_dds, contrast=c("age_fac_sex", "4_Farm_Male","4_Vivarium_Male"))
res_df <- as.data.frame(res) %>% dplyr::filter(padj < p_cutoff, log2FoldChange > fc_cutoff)
UP_4BM <- rownames(res_df)

res <- results(liver_dds, contrast=c("age_fac_sex", "4_Farm_Female", "4_Vivarium_Female"))
res_df <- as.data.frame(res) %>% dplyr::filter(padj < p_cutoff, log2FoldChange > fc_cutoff)
UP_4BF <-  rownames(res_df)

res <- results(liver_dds, contrast=c("age_fac_sex", "12_Farm_Male","12_Vivarium_Male"))
res_df = as.data.frame(res) %>% dplyr::filter(padj < p_cutoff, log2FoldChange > fc_cutoff)
UP_12BM <- rownames(res_df)

res <- results(liver_dds, contrast=c("age_fac_sex", "12_Farm_Female","12_Vivarium_Female"))
res_df = as.data.frame(res) %>% dplyr::filter(padj < p_cutoff, log2FoldChange > fc_cutoff)
UP_12BF <- rownames(res_df)

gene_sets_up <- list(
  "Week 4 Male" = UP_4BM,
  "Week 12 Male" = UP_12BM,
  "Week 4 Female" = UP_4BF,
  "Week 12 Female" = UP_12BF
  )

g_up <- ggvenn(gene_sets_up, fill_color = age_fac_color, set_name_size = 5, text_size = 5, show_percentage = F) + 
  labs(title="Genes Upregulated in Farm Mice")
g_up <- g_up + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16))


#down in Vivarium
res <- results(liver_dds, contrast=c("age_fac_sex", "4_Farm_Male","4_Vivarium_Male"))
res_df = as.data.frame(res) %>% dplyr::filter(padj < p_cutoff, log2FoldChange < -fc_cutoff)
Down_4BM <- rownames(res_df)

res <- results(liver_dds, contrast=c("age_fac_sex", "4_Farm_Female", "4_Vivarium_Female"))
res_df <- as.data.frame(res) %>% dplyr::filter(padj < p_cutoff, log2FoldChange < -fc_cutoff)
Down_4BF <-  rownames(res_df)

res <- results(liver_dds, contrast=c("age_fac_sex", "12_Farm_Male","12_Vivarium_Male"))
res_df = as.data.frame(res) %>% dplyr::filter(padj < p_cutoff, log2FoldChange < -fc_cutoff)
Down_12BM <- rownames(res_df)

res <- results(liver_dds, contrast=c("age_fac_sex", "12_Farm_Female","12_Vivarium_Female"))
res_df = as.data.frame(res) %>% dplyr::filter(padj < p_cutoff, log2FoldChange < -fc_cutoff)
Down_12BF <- rownames(res_df)

gene_sets_down <- list(
  "Week 4 Male" = Down_4BM,
  "Week 12 Male" = Down_12BM,
  "Week 4 Female" = Down_4BF,
  "Week 12 Female" = Down_12BF
  )

g_down <- ggvenn(gene_sets_down, fill_color = age_fac_color, set_name_size = 5, text_size = 5, show_percentage = F) +
  labs(title="Genes Downregulated in Farm Mice")
g_down <- g_down + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16))

save_fixed_panels(plots = list(g_up, g_down),
                  ncol = 2, shared_legend = TRUE,
                  panel_height = 4, panel_width = 5.5,
                  filename = paste0(out, "Liver_valcano_FigureS6FG.pdf"),
                  tags = c("F","G"))

```

### Sex gene
```{r}
norm <- counts(liver_dds, normalized = T)
marker_genes <- genelist |> filter(mgi_symbol %in% c("Xist", "Sry", "Ddx3y", "Eif2s3y", "Kdm5d", "Uty")) |>
  filter(ensembl_gene_id %in% rownames(norm)) |> select(ensembl_gene_id, mgi_symbol) |> unique()

qcdat <- as.data.frame(norm[marker_genes$ensembl_gene_id,]) |>
  rownames_to_column("ensembl_gene_id") |> 
  pivot_longer(-ensembl_gene_id, names_to = "TubeID", values_to = "normalized_count") |>
  left_join(marker_genes, by = "ensembl_gene_id") |> left_join(liverMD, by = "TubeID") |> 
  mutate(Week = factor(str_c("Week ", SamplingWeeks), levels = c("Week 4","Week 12")))

g <- ggplot(qcdat, aes(Sex, log2(normalized_count + 1), color = Sex)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.5) + geom_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, size = 1.5) +
  facet_grid(mgi_symbol ~ Week, scales = "free_y") + scale_color_manual(values = col_sex) +
  labs(y = "log2(normalized count + 1)", x = NULL, title = paste("sex-marker QC")) + theme_bw() + theme_all

ggsave(file = paste0(out,"Liver_sex_QC.pdf"),
       plot = g, width = 7, height = 10, units = "in", dpi = 300, device = "pdf")

```

### Differentiate gene heatmap
```{r}
res <- results(liver_dds, contrast=c("age_fac_sex", "4_Farm_Male", "4_Vivarium_Male"))
male4_sig <- res[!is.na(res$padj) & res$padj < 0.05 & abs(res$log2FoldChange) > 2, ] %>% as.data.frame() %>% arrange(padj) %>% slice(1:30) %>% rownames()

res <- results(liver_dds, contrast=c("age_fac_sex", "12_Farm_Male", "12_Vivarium_Male"))
male12_sig <- res[!is.na(res$padj) & res$padj < 0.05 & abs(res$log2FoldChange) > 2, ] %>% as.data.frame() %>% arrange(padj) %>% slice(1:30) %>% rownames()

res <- results(liver_dds, contrast=c("age_fac_sex", "4_Farm_Female", "4_Vivarium_Female"))
female4_sig <- res[!is.na(res$padj) & res$padj < 0.05 & abs(res$log2FoldChange) > 2, ] %>% as.data.frame() %>% arrange(padj) %>% slice(1:30) %>% rownames()

res <- results(liver_dds, contrast=c("age_fac_sex", "12_Farm_Female", "12_Vivarium_Female"))
female12_sig <- res[!is.na(res$padj) & res$padj < 0.05 & abs(res$log2FoldChange) > 2, ] %>% as.data.frame() %>% arrange(padj) %>% slice(1:30) %>% rownames()

genes <- c(male4_sig, male12_sig, female4_sig, female12_sig)

vsd <- vst(liver_dds, blind=FALSE)
mat <- assay(vsd)[genes, ]

group <- colData(liver_dds)$age_fac_sex
keep <- group %in% c("4_Vivarium_Male", "4_Farm_Male", "12_Vivarium_Male", "12_Farm_Male", 
                     "4_Vivarium_Female", "4_Farm_Female", "12_Vivarium_Female", "12_Farm_Female")
mat <- mat[, keep]
anno <- data.frame(group=group[keep])
rownames(anno) <- colnames(mat)
anno <- mutate(anno, Sex = ifelse(grepl("Female",anno$group), "Female", "Male"),
               Age = ifelse(grepl("4",anno$group), "4 weeks", "12 weeks"),
               Facility = ifelse(grepl("Vivarium",anno$group), "Vivarium", "Farm")) |> 
  select(-group)

temp_meta <- liverMD[order(liverMD$Facility), ]
temp_meta <- mutate(temp_meta, SamplingWeeks = ifelse(grepl("4",temp_meta$SamplingWeeks), "4 weeks", "12 weeks")) 
mat <- mat[, temp_meta$TubeID]

col_fun = colorRamp2(c(-4, 0, 4), c("#334b8c", "lemonchiffon", "red1"))

mat_scaled <- t(scale(t(mat))) %>% 
  as.data.frame(.) %>% 
  rownames_to_column(., "gene_id") %>% 
  mutate(., mgi_symbol = genelist$mgi_symbol[match(.$gene_id, genelist$ensembl_gene_id)]) %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  column_to_rownames(., "mgi_symbol") %>% 
  .[, -c(1)] %>% 
  as.matrix()

#Supervised by facility
col_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Facility = temp_meta$Facility,
  Age = temp_meta$SamplingWeeks,
  Sex = temp_meta$Sex,
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  col = list(
    Facility = c("Vivarium" = "#252525", "Farm" = "#1b9e77"),
    Age = c("4 weeks" = "#f9966d", "12 weeks" = "navy"),
    Sex = c("Male" = "#2b8cbe", "Female" = "#f1726d")
  )
)

p <- Heatmap(
  mat_scaled,
  width = ncol(mat_scaled) * unit(2, "mm"), 
  height = nrow(mat_scaled) * unit(4, "mm"),
  name = "Z-score",
  top_annotation = col_anno,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,       # unsupervised clustering within each block
  column_split = temp_meta$Facility,        # separate blocks by facility
  show_column_dend = TRUE,      # dendrograms for each block
  show_row_dend = TRUE,
  column_title = "Differentially Expressed Genes in Liver",
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  column_title_side = "top",
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontface = "bold")
)

p1 <- draw(p, merge_legends = TRUE, heatmap_legend_side = "right", 
           annotation_legend_side = "right")
pdf(file = paste0(out,"Liver_Heatmap_facility_supervised.pdf"), bg = "white",
    width = ComplexHeatmap:::width(p1) %>% as.numeric()/25.4, 
    height = ComplexHeatmap:::height(p1) %>% as.numeric()/25.4, useDingbats = F)
draw(p1)
dev.off()

```

### Pathway GSEA Facility by clusterprofiler
```{r}
##
res_w4M <- get_gsea_kegg(liver_dds, "4_Farm_Male", "4_Vivarium_Male")
res_w4F <- get_gsea_kegg(liver_dds, "4_Farm_Female", "4_Vivarium_Female")
res_w12M <- get_gsea_kegg(liver_dds, "12_Farm_Male", "12_Vivarium_Male")
res_w12F <- get_gsea_kegg(liver_dds, "12_Farm_Female", "12_Vivarium_Female")

dat <- rbind(res_w4M@result |> as.data.frame() |> mutate(Week = "Week 4", Sex = "Male"),
             res_w4F@result |> as.data.frame() |> mutate(Week = "Week 4", Sex = "Female"),
             res_w12M@result |> as.data.frame() |> mutate(Week = "Week 12", Sex = "Male"),
             res_w12F@result |> as.data.frame() |> mutate(Week = "Week 12", Sex = "Female"))



## search KEGG pathway class, run once
library(KEGGREST)
ids <- dat$ID |> unique()
batches <- split(ids, ceiling(seq_along(ids) / 10))
kegg_class <- map_dfr(batches, function(batch) {
  Sys.sleep(0.4)
  entries <- keggGet(batch)
  map_dfr(entries, function(x) {
    classes <- if (length(x$CLASS)) x$CLASS else NA_character_
    map_dfr(classes, function(cl) {
      levels <- if (is.na(cl)) {
        c(NA_character_, NA_character_)
      } else {
        trimws(strsplit(cl, ";", fixed = TRUE)[[1]])
      }
      tibble(
        ID     = sub("\\s.*$", "", x$ENTRY[1]),
        Level1 = levels[1],
        Level2 = levels[2],
        Level3 = if (length(x$NAME)) {
          sub(" - .*$", "", x$NAME[1])
        } else {
          NA_character_
        }
      )
    })
  })
}) |> distinct()

### manually fill KEGG level
kegg_class |> filter(is.na(Level1)) |> pull(ID)
kegg_class[which(kegg_class$ID == "mmu01212"), "Level1"] <- "Metabolism"
kegg_class[which(kegg_class$ID == "mmu01212"), "Level2"] <- "Global and overview maps"
kegg_class[which(kegg_class$ID == "mmu01210"), "Level1"] <- "Metabolism"
kegg_class[which(kegg_class$ID == "mmu01210"), "Level2"] <- "Global and overview maps"
kegg_class[which(kegg_class$ID == "mmu01230"), "Level1"] <- "Metabolism"
kegg_class[which(kegg_class$ID == "mmu01230"), "Level2"] <- "Global and overview maps"
kegg_class[which(kegg_class$ID == "mmu01200"), "Level1"] <- "Metabolism"
kegg_class[which(kegg_class$ID == "mmu01200"), "Level2"] <- "Global and overview maps"
kegg_class[which(kegg_class$ID == "mmu01240"), "Level1"] <- "Metabolism"
kegg_class[which(kegg_class$ID == "mmu01240"), "Level2"] <- "Global and overview maps"

write.table( dat |> left_join(kegg_class, by = "ID"),
             file = paste0(out, "GSEA_Liver_shrink_kegg_class_added.tsv"),
             row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE, sep = "\t")
```

```{r}
  mutate(Week = factor(str_c("Week ", SamplingWeeks), levels = c("Week 4","Week 12")))

g <- ggplot(qcdat, aes(Sex, log2(normalized_count + 1), color = Sex)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.5) + geom_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, size = 1.5) +
  facet_grid(mgi_symbol ~ Week, scales = "free_y") + scale_color_manual(values = col_sex) +
  labs(y = "log2(normalized count + 1)", x = NULL, title = paste("sex-marker QC")) + theme_bw() + theme_all

ggsave(file = paste0(out,"Ileum_sex_QC.pdf"),
       plot = g, width = 7, height = 10, units = "in", dpi = 300, device = "pdf")

```

### Differentiate gene heatmap
```{r}
res <- results(ileum_dds, contrast=c("age_fac_sex", "4_Farm_Male", "4_Vivarium_Male"))
male4_sig <- res[!is.na(res$padj) & res$padj < 0.05 & abs(res$log2FoldChange) > 2, ] %>% as.data.frame() %>% arrange(padj) %>% slice(1:30) %>% rownames()

res <- results(ileum_dds, contrast=c("age_fac_sex", "12_Farm_Male", "12_Vivarium_Male"))
male12_sig <- res[!is.na(res$padj) & res$padj < 0.05 & abs(res$log2FoldChange) > 2, ] %>% as.data.frame() %>% arrange(padj) %>% slice(1:30) %>% rownames()

res <- results(ileum_dds, contrast=c("age_fac_sex", "4_Farm_Female", "4_Vivarium_Female"))
female4_sig <- res[!is.na(res$padj) & res$padj < 0.05 & abs(res$log2FoldChange) > 2, ] %>% as.data.frame() %>% arrange(padj) %>% slice(1:30) %>% rownames()

res <- results(ileum_dds, contrast=c("age_fac_sex", "12_Farm_Female", "12_Vivarium_Female"))
female12_sig <- res[!is.na(res$padj) & res$padj < 0.05 & abs(res$log2FoldChange) > 2, ] %>% as.data.frame() %>% arrange(padj) %>% slice(1:30) %>% rownames()

genes <- c(male4_sig, male12_sig, female4_sig, female12_sig)

vsd <- vst(ileum_dds, blind=FALSE)
mat <- assay(vsd)[genes, ]

group <- colData(ileum_dds)$age_fac_sex
keep <- group %in% c("4_Vivarium_Male", "4_Farm_Male", "12_Vivarium_Male", "12_Farm_Male", 
                     "4_Vivarium_Female", "4_Farm_Female", "12_Vivarium_Female", "12_Farm_Female")
mat <- mat[, keep]
anno <- data.frame(group=group[keep])
rownames(anno) <- colnames(mat)
anno <- mutate(anno, Sex = ifelse(grepl("Female",anno$group), "Female", "Male"),
               Age = ifelse(grepl("4",anno$group), "4 weeks", "12 weeks"),
               Facility = ifelse(grepl("Vivarium",anno$group), "Vivarium", "Farm")) |> 
  select(-group)

temp_meta <- ileumMD[order(ileumMD$Facility), ]
temp_meta <- mutate(temp_meta, SamplingWeeks = ifelse(grepl("4",temp_meta$SamplingWeeks), "4 weeks", "12 weeks")) 
mat <- mat[, temp_meta$TubeID]

col_fun = colorRamp2(c(-4, 0, 4), c("#334b8c", "lemonchiffon", "red1"))

mat_scaled <- t(scale(t(mat))) %>% 
  as.data.frame(.) %>% 
  rownames_to_column(., "gene_id") %>% 
  mutate(., mgi_symbol = genelist$mgi_symbol[match(.$gene_id, genelist$ensembl_gene_id)]) %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  column_to_rownames(., "mgi_symbol") %>% 
  .[, -c(1)] %>% 
  as.matrix()

#Supervised by facility
col_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Facility = temp_meta$Facility,
  Age = temp_meta$SamplingWeeks,
  Sex = temp_meta$Sex,
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  col = list(
    Facility = c("Vivarium" = "#252525", "Farm" = "#1b9e77"),
    Age = c("4 weeks" = "#f9966d", "12 weeks" = "navy"),
    Sex = c("Male" = "#2b8cbe", "Female" = "#f1726d")
  )
)

p <- Heatmap(
  mat_scaled,
  width = ncol(mat_scaled) * unit(2, "mm"), 
  height = nrow(mat_scaled) * unit(4, "mm"),
  name = "Z-score",
  top_annotation = col_anno,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,       # unsupervised clustering within each block
  column_split = temp_meta$Facility,        # separate blocks by facility
  show_column_dend = TRUE,      # dendrograms for each block
  show_row_dend = TRUE,
  column_title = "Differentially Expressed Genes in Ileum",
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  column_title_side = "top",
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontface = "bold")
)

p1 <- draw(p, merge_legends = TRUE, heatmap_legend_side = "right", 
           annotation_legend_side = "right")
pdf(file = paste0(out,"Ileum_Heatmap_facility_supervised.pdf"), bg = "white",
    width = ComplexHeatmap:::width(p1) %>% as.numeric()/25.4, 
    height = ComplexHeatmap:::height(p1) %>% as.numeric()/25.4, useDingbats = F)
draw(p1)
dev.off()
```

### Pathway GSEA Facility by clusterprofiler
```{r}
##
res_w4M <- get_gsea_kegg(ileum_dds, "4_Farm_Male", "4_Vivarium_Male")
res_w4F <- get_gsea_kegg(ileum_dds, "4_Farm_Female", "4_Vivarium_Female")
res_w12M <- get_gsea_kegg(ileum_dds, "12_Farm_Male", "12_Vivarium_Male")
res_w12F <- get_gsea_kegg(ileum_dds, "12_Farm_Female", "12_Vivarium_Female")

dat <- rbind(res_w4M@result |> as.data.frame() |> mutate(Week = "Week 4", Sex = "Male"),
             res_w4F@result |> as.data.frame() |> mutate(Week = "Week 4", Sex = "Female"),
             res_w12M@result |> as.data.frame() |> mutate(Week = "Week 12", Sex = "Male"),
             res_w12F@result |> as.data.frame() |> mutate(Week = "Week 12", Sex = "Female"))


# search KEGG pathway class, run once
library(KEGGREST)
ids <- dat$ID |> unique()
batches <- split(ids, ceiling(seq_along(ids) / 10))
kegg_class <- map_dfr(batches, function(batch) {
  Sys.sleep(0.4)
  entries <- keggGet(batch)
  map_dfr(entries, function(x) {
    classes <- if (length(x$CLASS)) x$CLASS else NA_character_
    map_dfr(classes, function(cl) {
      levels <- if (is.na(cl)) {
        c(NA_character_, NA_character_)
      } else {
        trimws(strsplit(cl, ";", fixed = TRUE)[[1]])
      }
      tibble(
        ID     = sub("\\s.*$", "", x$ENTRY[1]),
        Level1 = levels[1],
        Level2 = levels[2],
        Level3 = if (length(x$NAME)) {
          sub(" - .*$", "", x$NAME[1])
        } else {
          NA_character_
        }
      )
    })
  })
}) |> distinct()

### manually fill KEGG level
kegg_class |> filter(is.na(Level1)) |> pull(ID)
kegg_class[which(kegg_class$ID == "mmu01212"), "Level1"] <- "Metabolism"
kegg_class[which(kegg_class$ID == "mmu01212"), "Level2"] <- "Global and overview maps"
kegg_class[which(kegg_class$ID == "mmu01210"), "Level1"] <- "Metabolism"
kegg_class[which(kegg_class$ID == "mmu01210"), "Level2"] <- "Global and overview maps"
kegg_class[which(kegg_class$ID == "mmu01230"), "Level1"] <- "Metabolism"
kegg_class[which(kegg_class$ID == "mmu01230"), "Level2"] <- "Global and overview maps"
kegg_class[which(kegg_class$ID == "mmu01200"), "Level1"] <- "Metabolism"
kegg_class[which(kegg_class$ID == "mmu01200"), "Level2"] <- "Global and overview maps"
kegg_class[which(kegg_class$ID == "mmu01240"), "Level1"] <- "Metabolism"
kegg_class[which(kegg_class$ID == "mmu01240"), "Level2"] <- "Global and overview maps"

write.table( dat |> left_join(kegg_class, by = "ID"),
             file = paste0(out, "GSEA_Ileum_shrink_kegg_class_added.tsv"),
             row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE, sep = "\t")

```

## GSEA in both tissue shrinklfc
```{r}
res_liver <- read.table(paste0(out,"GSEA_Liver_shrink_kegg_class_added.tsv"), sep = "\t", header = TRUE) |> 
  mutate(Tissue = "Liver")
res_ileum <- read.table(paste0(out,"GSEA_Ileum_shrink_kegg_class_added.tsv"), sep = "\t", header = TRUE) |> 
  mutate(Tissue = "Ileum")

dat <- rbind(res_liver, res_ileum)

dat_w <- dat |> 
  select(ID, Level1, Level2, Description, NES,Tissue, Week, Sex) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = c(Tissue, Week, Sex),
    values_from = NES,
    names_sep = "_") 

mat <- dat_w |>
  select(-ID, -Description, -Level1, -Level2) |>
  as.matrix()

rownames(mat) <- make.unique(dat_w$Description)

col_anno <- tibble(Sample = colnames(mat)) |>
  mutate(Tissue = str_extract(Sample, "^[^_]+"),
         Age = str_extract(Sample, "Week \\d+"),
         Sex = str_extract(Sample, "Male|Female$"))

col_order <- order(
  factor(col_anno$Tissue, levels = c("Liver", "Ileum")),
  factor(col_anno$Age, levels = c("Week 4", "Week 12")),
  factor(col_anno$Sex, levels = c("Male", "Female"))
)

mat <- mat[, col_order, drop = FALSE]
col_anno <- col_anno[col_order, ]

row_group <- dat_w$Level1
row_group[is.na(row_group)] <- "Unknown"
groups <- unique(row_group)

group_cols <- setNames(colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Set2"))(length(groups)),groups)

ha_row <- rowAnnotation(
  KEGG = row_group,
  col = list(KEGG = group_cols),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  annotation_name_side = "top",
  width = unit(5, "mm")
)

ha_col <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Age = col_anno$Age,
  Sex = col_anno$Sex,
  col = list(Age = c("Week 4" = "#f9966d", "Week 12" = "navy"),
             Sex = c("Male" = "#2b8cbe", "Female" = "#f1726d")),
  annotation_name_side = "left"
)

lim <- max(abs(mat), na.rm = TRUE)
col_fun <- colorRamp2( c(-lim, 0, lim), c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))

p <- Heatmap(
  mat,
  name = "Normalized enrichment score",
  col = col_fun,
  na_col = "grey75",
  width = ncol(mat) * unit(10, "mm"),
  height = nrow(mat) * unit(5, "mm"),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  column_split = factor(col_anno$Tissue,levels = c("Liver", "Ileum")),
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  left_annotation = ha_row,
  row_names_side = "right",
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  row_names_max_width = max_text_width(rownames(mat), gp = gpar(fontsize = 8)),
  row_split = factor(row_group,levels = unique(row_group)),
  row_title = NULL,
  #column_labels = c("Male", "Female","Male", "Female"),
  column_title_rot = 90,
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  top_annotation = ha_col,
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "white",lwd = 0.5),
  row_gap = unit(1.5, "mm"),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Normalized enrichment score",
    at = c(-lim, 0, lim),
    labels = round(c(-lim, 0, lim), 1)
  )
)

p1 <- draw(p, merge_legends = TRUE, heatmap_legend_side = "right", 
           annotation_legend_side = "right")

pdf(file = paste0(out,"Kegg_NES_combined_shrink.pdf"), bg = "white",
    width = ComplexHeatmap:::width(p1) %>% as.numeric()/25.4, 
    height = ComplexHeatmap:::height(p1) %>% as.numeric()/25.4, useDingbats = F)
draw(p1)
dev.off()

```

## PERMANOVA table
```{r}
res_liver <- perm_liver |> as.data.frame() |> 
  rownames_to_column(var = "Variable") |> 
  transmute(Organ = "Liver", Variable, 
            Df = Df, 
            Sum_of_Sqs = round(SumOfSqs,3),
            R2 = round(R2, 3),
            `F` = round(`F`, 3),
            Pvalue = `Pr(>F)`) |> 
  filter(!is.na(Pvalue))

res_liver$qval <- p.adjust(res_liver$Pvalue, method = "BH")

res_ileum <- perm_ileum |> as.data.frame() |> 
  rownames_to_column(var = "Variable") |> 
  transmute(Organ = "Ileum", Variable, 
            Df = Df, 
            Sum_of_Sqs = round(SumOfSqs,3),
            R2 = round(R2, 3),
            `F` = round(`F`, 3),
            Pvalue = `Pr(>F)`) |> 
  filter(!is.na(Pvalue))

res_ileum$qval <- p.adjust(res_ileum$Pvalue, method = "BH")
          
res <- rbind(res_liver, res_ileum) |> 
  mutate(qval = round(qval,3))

write.csv(res, file = paste0(out, "RNAseq_permanova.csv"),
          quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
```
